soundness_flags.label: thm:hac-exactness and thm:uniform-wald
soundness_flags.one_line: The class supplies only memberwise-in-P bandwidth divergence, growth, and covariance-tail limits, but these theorems assert uniformity over P (and the Wald theorem takes sup_P); arbitrary law-specific delayed bandwidth sequences satisfy the class while defeating any uniform conclusion.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:endogenous-random-metric; thm:hac-exactness; thm:uniform-wald
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The random-metric quadratic implication is openly unresolved and the exact-HAC and Wald claims depend on its affirmative resolution.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Treat the exactness and coverage headline as conditional on a proved affirmative resolution of the stated endogenous-random-metric question; this is not an assumed comparator formula or assumed target variance.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 4.5 requires errors independent of the network conditional on X; Remark 4.3 states its role in making disconnected agents conditionally uncorrelated for Theorem 4.2.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either replace every uniform-over-P conclusion by a pointwise result or strengthen the class with explicit sup_P probability bounds for bandwidth divergence, tail omission, boundary loss, and random-metric approximation.

Verify the 2022 Econometrica version directly and repair all theorem-number references: the accessible preprint has Theorem 2 as consistency, Theorem 3 as the CLT, and Theorem 4 as variance estimation.

Make the random-metric question decisive by proving a primitive endpoint-influence sufficient condition or producing a legal counterexample, then state the exact-HAC theorem under that resolved condition rather than leaving the package conditional.

recommended_next_step: Continue revising this angle: formalize uniform class conditions and resolve or conditionally isolate the endogenous-random-metric lemma, while source-verifying the exact published Leung2022 theorem numbering.
